learning_outcomes.text: Acquire comparative knowledge of the basic properties of the most common building materials, and their properties and applications in buildings and structures.
Be able to make a decision about selection, design, and use of materials in constructions.
Be able to apply design concepts to produce concrete with sufficient strength and durability according to specifications and basic requirements.
Understand how characteristics of building materials can be related to the structural aspects.

syllabus_topics: Masonry as a construction material: mortar, bricks, building blocks
Cement, concrete aggregates, admixtures and additives
Mechanical and physical properties of concrete
Durability requirements and prescription of concrete according to standards

assessment_methods.method: Written exam during the examination period (calculation and theoretical questions)

assessment_rules: The exam will consist of assignments (calculations, theoretical questions) to assess the understanding of basic knowledge and learning outcomes.
institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
